easyPrerequisites: Iceberg has at least one ice counter on it.
description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying its mana cost.
Inexorable Tide and Equilibrium trigger.
Resolve the Inexorable Tide trigger, causing you to proliferate, thus putting an ice counter on Iceberg.
Holding priority, activate Iceberg's second ability by removing an ice counter, adding {C}.
Resolve the Equilibrium trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Phyrexian Walker from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying its mana cost.
Inexorable Tide and Equilibrium trigger.
Resolve the Inexorable Tide trigger, causing you to proliferate, thus putting an ice counter on Iceberg.
Holding priority, activate Iceberg's second ability by removing an ice counter, adding {C}.
Resolve the Equilibrium trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Crimson Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
